funding.name: IAMCR Travel Grants
funding.amount_note: Up to 18 grants, each max USD 2,000
funding.cycle: Annual, tied to each year's IAMCR conference; the 2026 (Galway) deadline was 20 Mar 2026 — the 2027 São Paulo cycle's deadline is not yet posted

funding.why: She would likely qualify on career stage and country of residence, but the São Paulo 2027 CFP hasn't opened yet (expected Nov 2026), so there's no paper to be accepted against this cycle
funding.source_quote: Up to 18 grants, each max USD 2,000

funding.name: ICSSR Scheme for Participation in International Seminar/Conference Abroad
funding.amount_note: PhD/PDF scholars without other funding: full financial assistance (airfare, visa, insurance, local conveyance, stay, registration).
funding.cycle: Rolling, apply online at least 3 months before the conference date once a paper is accepted
funding.requires: Formal acceptance letter from organizers to present a paper (email invites insufficient) + full paper
funding.why: Applicable only once she has a paper accepted for IAMCR 2027, which itself requires the November 2026 CFP to open first
funding.source_quote: PhD/PDF scholars and SC/ST/PwD faculty without other funding: full financial assistance.
funding.sequence_note: Apply to ICSSR at least 3 months before the 18 Jul 2027 travel date (by roughly Apr 2027) once IAMCR paper acceptance is confirmed.

registration.note: 2027 fees not yet published (CFP opens Nov 2026); estimated from typical IAMCR-scale annual congress student registration (~USD 150-250), not grounded to a page

travel.note: India-São Paulo return economy; no direct flights exist (1+ stops via Europe/Middle East/US), web fares found ranged roughly USD 885 up to much higher depending on season/routing; Brazil isn't in the standard regional heuristic table so this is a wider, more conservative band

accommodation.note: 6 nights in São Paulo (5 conference days + 1), hostel/budget to mid-range hotel

visa.note: Brazil has no e-visa route for Indian passport holders; traditional visa via the Brazilian consulate/embassy in India, typical fee ~INR 8,000-10,000, 10-15 day processing plus appointment wait; yellow fever vaccination is also recommended
